messages:
noelle (product): Quick GA note: Polaris Edge is GA on the Hosted API 680. It's our low-latency edge offering: geo-aware routing, region pinning, and an "edge-chunk" compact streaming format for faster client parsing. Rolling to us-west-2, eu-west-3 today; APAC regions later this week. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/polaris-edge

kai (eng-runtime): API summary: new endpoint POST /v2/edge. Opt-in header: X-RW-Edge: polaris. Supports both streaming and single-shot generation. Use connection_id + stream_key for long-lived connections. Models at GA: polaris-edge-3b, polaris-edge-7b-lite. Designed for p95 <50ms in nearby POPs.

abby (devex): Quick examples: JS: 
const conn = client.edge.connect({model:'polaris-edge-3b', region:'auto', connection_id:'c-42'});

Curl (single-shot):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-RW-Edge: polaris" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"polaris-edge-7b-lite","prompt":"Summarize...","session_id":"s-edge"}' \n  https://api.redwood.com/v2/edge

omar (eng-sre): Observability: Polaris dashboards live in Console. Default alerts: region-tail-latency p95 > 80ms for 3m, edge-error-rate > 1% for 5m. We're pre-warming micro-pools per POP and monitoring fallback-to-core metric if local capacity is saturated.

deploy-bot: polaris-edge@stable deployed at 2688889005 :white_check_mark:

rita (docs): Migration & best practices: https://redwood.example.com/docs/polaris-migrate. Note: edge-chunk framing uses a small _hdr block followed by chunk arrays; use SDK parsers to avoid parsing edge cases. Also documented region pinning and how to prefer a specific POP via region header X-RW-POP: <pop-id>.

sam (customer-success): We're scheduling an early-adopter demo for customers who care about <100ms UI interactions. Office hours Thurs 11am PT. Dedicated/private customers: if you need an on-prem connector or reserved POPs, open a support ticket and we'll coordinate.

felix (legal): Policy note: enabling external tool-calls from public projects on edge models requires an additional data flow attestation (we added a console checkbox). This is to ensure outbound allowlists and audit trails are in place for edge POPs. If you need an exemption for Dedicated, please route via your account manager.

kai (eng-runtime): Compatibility: legacy /v1/edge-preview will remain for 60 days then be deprecated. We provide a compatibility shim for basic streaming but advanced features (POP pinning, edge-chunk) require /v2/edge. If you need extra migration time, file an eng-runtime ticket.

noelle (product): Thanks team 389. We'll post a short external blurb and add a migration checklist to the Console. If folks on infra or devex want to run internal demos, DM me and we'll coordinate a slot.
